crossRefs.note: God who is wise in heart, and mighty in strength: who has hardened himself against him and prospered?
Because he has stretched out his hand against God, and behaves himself proudly against the Almighty,
he runs at him with a stiff neck, with the thick shields of his bucklers,
Or do you have an arm like God? Can you thunder with a voice like him?
Should an ax brag against him who chops with it? Should a saw exalt itself above him who saws with it? As if a rod…
Yahweh, your hand is lifted up, yet they don’t see; but they will see your zeal for the people, and be disappointed.…
Whom have you defied and blasphemed? Against whom have you exalted your voice and lifted up your eyes on high? Against…
By your servants, you have defied the Lord, and have said, “With the multitude of my chariots I have come up to the…
Because of your raging against me, and because your arrogance has come up into my ears, therefore I will put my hook in…
Woe to him who strives with his Maker— a clay pot among the clay pots of the earth! Shall the clay ask him who fashions…
Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him, because he didn’t give God the glory. Then he was eaten by worms and died.
Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than he?

translations.web: because you still exalt yourself against my people, that you won’t let them go.
translations.bsb: Still, you lord it over My people and do not allow them to go.
translations.kjv: As yet exaltest thou thyself against my people, that thou wilt not let them go?
